_doc: Census families whose gap this lane has read in the transformers code (not all 51 Level C: the others are listed by the refusal the reader gave, in the generated census table, and are NOT classified). class: feature | route | refusal | data (an adapter is expected to hold, not yet written) ; frs: the feature requests (docs/design/palw/tir/feature-requests.md) that name it.

nanochat.short: q/k RMS norm AFTER the rotation, weightless norms everywhere, an extra norm on the embeddings, ReLU² ungated MLP; the standard template reads it and bind refutes it
nanochat.evidence: read from modeling_nanochat.py; adapter written (census-adapters-pending), expected to stop at float_vs_hf because the spec has only the pre-rotation q/k norm

modernbert_decoder.short: a prediction head (dense + activation + norm) before the tied vocabulary projection (FR-29); layer 0 has no attn_norm; the per-layer-type rope convention alone does not make it readable
modernbert_decoder.evidence: read from modeling_modernbert_decoder.py; the per-layer-type rope convention alone does not make it readable

axk2.evidence: the reader's own refusal: layer type deepseek_sparse_attention

glm_moe_dsa.short: DeepSeek sparse attention (interleaved indexer rope, shared indexer layers)

hy_v4.short: DSA indexer plus hyper-connections without a mixing matrix and swiglu_limit

codegen.short: qkv stored in an mp_num-partitioned layout the binder cannot express

olmo_hybrid.short: gated delta rule layers with SEPARATE q/k/v projections and convolutions (the GdnLayout enum has only Qwen3-Next's fused and Qwen3.5's split-projection layouts), allow_neg_eigval (beta times 2) and a different norm placement per layer type; the same split-conv shape as Kimi's KDA
olmo_hybrid.evidence: config and tensor names (q_conv1d, k_conv1d, v_conv1d, a_proj, b_proj, g_proj, o_norm)

minimax.short: lightning attention: linear attention with a constant per-head decay (Mamba-2's update without dt, conv or skip), an RMS norm over all heads and a SEPARATE sigmoid output gate; hybrid with softmax attention layers

recurrent_gemma.short: RG-LRU recurrent blocks (a gated linear recurrence with a learned decay and a convolution) beside local attention: a new mixer, not yet read in detail

granitemoeshared_shared.short: the shared expert's gate and up are one fused tensor (shared_mlp.input_linear); the default tiny config has no shared expert, so `granitemoeshared` itself is Level B while every real checkpoint is blocked
granitemoeshared_shared.evidence: adapter: its own check refuses and names FR-01

afmoe.short: a SEPARATE output-gate tensor (self_attn.gate_proj [H*hd, D], sigmoid, per element): the binder reads an output gate only from the fused q_proj rows (Qwen3-Next layout); also rotary on the sliding layers only and pre/post norms around both sub-layers

laguna.short: a separate output-gate tensor with a SOFTPLUS activation, per head (self_attn.g_proj [H, D]; per element when gating is false), per-layer head counts, per-layer-type partial rotary, a router with logit soft-capping, a shared expert

mimo_v2_flash.short: attention_value_scale (values times 0.707) has no spec field; the rest (per-layer-type kv heads, sinks on the sliding layers only under the hub name attention_sink_bias, per-layer-type partial rotary, a sigmoid router with a correction bias) is data
mimo_v2_flash.evidence: read from modeling_mimo_v2_flash.py; an adapter that treats the scale as inert is expected to stop at float_vs_hf (not yet run: quiet window)

zaya.short: Zyphra's CCA attention (a convolution over q/k, a delayed value projection, a q/k norm with a learned temperature), per-layer residual scale/bias vectors, an MLP router with balancing biases, layer types `hybrid`/`hybrid_sliding`: several features at once
zaya.evidence: config and tensor names (the layer shows qkv_proj.conv_qk_depthwise, v_proj_delayed, router_mlp, *_residual_scale)

xglm.short: sinusoidal positions in a DECODER (the spec has learned positions only), and the embedding scale applies to the token embedding only (FR-34); otherwise OPT-like

doge.short: dynamic-mask attention (a learned `A` and `dt_proj` mask the keys) and residual vectors (input_residual, post_attention_residual): a new mixer

gpt_neox_japanese.short: an output-projection bias stored as a separate tensor (attention.dense_bias) added outside the projection on some layers

cohere2_moe.short: expected Level B: Cohere2's parallel block with a top-k MoE; written (census-adapters-pending), not yet run; a shared expert combined by `average` needs a scale on the shared expert

aria_text.short: experts stacked and TRANSPOSED (experts.fc1.weight [E, in, 2I], fc2 [E, I, out]): a layout the binder has no name for
aria_text.evidence: adapter written, expected to stop at bind (pending validation)

biogpt.short: OPT's block under another prefix, but the embedding scale multiplies the token embedding only (the builder multiplies token + position): expected to stop at float_vs_hf; the variant without the scale shows the rest is data
biogpt.evidence: read from hl/build.rs and modeling_biogpt.py; adapter written, pending validation

openai_gpt.short: expected Level B: GPT-2's tensors in a post-norm block without a final norm; written, not yet run

gemma4_unified_text.short: expected Level B: the built-in gemma4-text without PLE and without the MoE block; written, not yet run

camembert.short: a BERT-lineage `ForCausalLM`: a BERT block under a causal mask whose output goes through an MLM prediction head (dense + activation + LayerNorm + bias) before the vocabulary projection
camembert.evidence: the fixture's tensor names (lm_head.dense / lm_head.layer_norm, cls.predictions.transform.*); not run
